title: A Ladder to Heaven
paragraphs: Jacob was running away, tired, lonely and in trouble of his own making. With a stone for a pillow he fell asleep in the open. And he dreamed: a stairway reaching from earth up to heaven, with angels going up and down. And God spoke, promising to be with him and never to leave him. Jacob woke up amazed. "Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn't know it." He had thought he was alone in the middle of nowhere. It turned out to be the very spot where heaven touched earth. Nobody is so far from home that God cannot find them. And one day heaven would come right down the ladder.
wonder: I wonder where you have felt close to God without expecting to?
activity: Build a ladder from paper strips; on each rung write something you are thankful for.
prayer: God who is with us everywhere, help us notice you in unexpected places. Amen.
alt: A sleeping traveller on a hillside dreams of a golden ladder reaching to the sky.
hidden: A tiny bird on the stone.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
